calibrate_run.description: Put the measuring cylinder at the outlet of the tube, then submit to start the calibration dose. This will dose between 2 and 4 ml and will take up to 5 seconds.

calibrate_measure.description: Enter exact volume of ml here. Place the measuring cylinder on a horizontal surface, check the level of the water surface, estimate the level of the bottom of the concave water surface to the nearest 0.05ml

calibrate_test.description: Make sure the tube measuring cylinder is empty and completely dry, then submit to dose a known 4 ml volume.

data.accurate: Was the 4 ml test dose accurate?

calibrate_accuracy.description: Was this accurate? (between 3.95-4.05ml). Choosing no restarts the calibration.

calibrate_dose_unclear.description: The {dose} may or may not have run: the frame was sent, but the connection failed before the pump confirmed it. Retry sends the dose frame again (dosing a second time if the first run happened); Continue moves on without dosing again.
